title: External side-effect without idempotency key
detects: code contains external/payment/stripe/charge/http call without idempotency
why: Network boundary creates ambiguous outcome; retry may duplicate side effect.
required: idempotency key persisted before external call

title: Multiple DB writes without transaction
detects: multiple execute/update/insert without BEGIN/COMMIT or atomic block
why: Crash between writes leaves partial state.

title: External charge before DB transaction
detects: stripe.charge or payment before db transaction
why: External effect cannot be rolled back; DB failure leaves charged but not recorded.
required: persist pending payment before external call

title: No retry handling for transient failures
why: Transient failures become permanent without retry.

title: Unsafe retry on non-idempotent operation
detects: retry loop wrapping non-idempotent operation without key
required: make operation idempotent before adding retry

title: External call without timeout
why: Hung dependency exhausts workers; timeout outcome ambiguous.

title: Read-modify-write without locking
detects: SELECT then UPDATE on same record without FOR UPDATE/version
required: SELECT FOR UPDATE or optimistic locking version check

title: Queue processing without ack/idempotency handling
detects: queue/worker/consumer without ack or idempotent processing
why: Crash before ack causes redelivery and duplicate processing.

title: No operation ID / logging for traceability
detects: handler without request ID or structured log
why: Cannot reconstruct what happened after failure.
tests: trigger failure then search logs by ID
